args.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a finished native vertical comic page, EXACTLY THREE full-width horizontal tiers stacked top to bottom, slim clean gutters, no inset panels. This page depicts three consecutive moments in Nightglass Courier. Reference image 1 supplies original elegant anime drawing and inhabited navy city atmosphere, not its layout or creature. Reference image 2 supplies adult Aren and older Pell identity/clothes; exclude the creature, Sera, and Pell's tall tool rig. Never copy sheet background. NO TEXT, NO BALLOONS, NO NUMBERS. Leave calm upper background inside each tier for later editable lettering.

Treatment: thin controlled anime contours, appealing angular face, broad navy/cyan shadow shapes with selective amber domestic lamps, quiet matte stone and metal rail construction. Aren: slim adult man, swept midnight hair, gray eyes, ivory long-sleeved waist jacket, fitted black high neck, slim black trousers, red courier cord. His jacket LOWER HEM already has one small ragged tear from earlier work, BOTH SLEEVES INTACT in every tier. One silver crescent short sword with black straight hilt and cyan pommel ring, anatomical RIGHT-hand weapon. Cream original dispatch wallet remains at belt. Pell: older gray-haired stubbled man in mustard maintenance jacket and worn ordinary harness, NO long rig/tool or weapon.

Shared geography: narrow upper postal stair landing at left; separate lower stone landing three metres down-right, connected by old stairs blocked by a closed iron wicket. A stout BLACK metal anchor post stands on the lower landing beside a modest projecting iron handrail tooth. Inhabited vertical night city beyond. The black envelope is one flat small BLACK sealed envelope, broken silver-circle seal, distinct from the cream belt wallet.

TOP TIER, N1-31, close hands with both faces: Pell on picture left transfers the BLACK envelope onto Aren's open anatomical LEFT palm at picture right. Freeze the completed handoff: envelope supported by Aren's left palm and Pell's fingertips just leaving its edge. Aren's anatomical RIGHT hand rests on his sheathed sword hilt at his RIGHT hip. Both stand on upper landing. No cyan line. Faces quiet, Pell earnest, Aren attentive. Preserve empty upper left area for Pell's eventual speech.

MIDDLE TIER, N1-32, chest/waist three-quarter: Aren has tucked the entire same black envelope into the inside chest pocket of his ivory jacket with his LEFT hand; his left hand is just leaving the pocket opening, envelope FULLY CONCEALED, not clipped to belt. His RIGHT hand has drawn the ONE crescent sword. Pell watches behind on upper stair, his hands now EMPTY of envelope. No cyan line. Show the intact long sleeves and earlier ragged lower hem. Calm upper area for Aren's later speech.

BOTTOM TIER, N1-33, wider side view with Aren's whole body and both endpoints: Aren steps off the upper stair, boots airborne, heading toward the lower stone landing THREE metres DOWN-RIGHT. His RIGHT hand holds the crescent sword with blade directed left, AWAY from the landing. ONE thin taut cyan line starts exactly at the cyan POMMEL RING BEHIND HIS RIGHT FIST and ends at the BLACK post on that lower landing. It must not originate on blade, blade tip, wrist, left hand or torso. Keep both endpoints clearly visible and the line visually separate from the silver blade. Left arm balances empty. Black envelope remains concealed inside chest pocket. Both sleeves intact, old hem tear persists. Pell remains standing on upper stair, empty-handed. The lower handrail tooth has no contact with Aren yet. No creatures, no extra people, no other lines, no duplicate weapons, no interface or lettering.
